exposure: history of late gestational age (29-32 weeks)
cohort: The study included 470 pregnant mothers attending antenatal care in Hadiya Zone public Hospitals, Southern Ethiopia.
finding: The prevalence of gestational diabetes mellitus was 26.2%, and it was significantly associated with urban residency, primary education, no prior history of abortion, history of late gestational age (29-32 weeks), no history of coffee drinking, and adequate dietary diversity.
